snapshot.description: Update dev-server.js and vercel.json so that mobile UA requests to the game URL are served the portrait app instead of the Godot landscape embed. Add a /portrait route for direct access. Desktop UAs continue to see the Godot game. Add a toggle link on both versions to switch.
